text: Send App is a remittance platform whose parent company is Flutterwave, a payments technology company founded and led by Olugbenga "GB" Agboola.

source.name: Flutterwave (company blog): Send App by Flutterwave Relaunches in the US with Expanded Money Transfer to Africa
source.quote: Send App is activating 20 additional direct licenses obtained by its parent company, Flutterwave, enabling efficient remittance services for millions of Africans
